title: Provide an offline optimize-save-decide walkthrough
description:
## Scope

Add a compact example and CLI or script that takes candidate/development labels, searches with a fake model, saves a policy, and applies it to a new unlabeled item. Document adapter configuration and the separation between library features and studies.

## Definition of done

A fresh clone can run the complete offline example with no keys or network. The README explains inputs, outputs, model capabilities, and how to follow linked experimental notes.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Terra delivered zero/one/two-per-label synthetic optimization, artifact save/reload and unlabeled decision. Independent make test: 147 passed; make demo reproduces stable artifact and IDs; wheel/sdist build succeeded; installed wheel console demo passed in fresh environment without dependencies, keys or network inference. README explicitly distinguishes synthetic demonstration from paid model evidence.
